identity.name: RevealIQ Study Companion
identity.core_philosophy: Study is a game you win. Focus is the currency.

typography.installation: Import from Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600&family=Outfit:wght@400;500;700;900&display=swap');

colors.palette_strategy: Archetype 2: Electric & Neon (Dark Mode) vs Archetype 4: Swiss High-Contrast (Light Mode)

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlay on dark backgrounds to prevent banding.

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-bold transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-lg hover:shadow-indigo-500/25
buttons.secondary: rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium border-2 border-border hover:bg-secondary transition-colors

cards.base: rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300

inputs.style: rounded-xl border-2 border-border bg-background px-4 py-3 focus:border-primary focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary/10 transition-all outline-none

motion.micro_interactions: Buttons scale on click. Cards lift on hover. Coins spin when earned.

landing_hero.alt: Student deeply focused on laptop in a library setting

wallet_header.alt: Pile of gold coins representing wealth and rewards

instructions_to_main_agent: Use .jsx extension for all React components.
Implement the 'Outfit' font for all headings to give a distinct brand feel.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' specifically for the Focus Timer countdown to make it look technical.
The 'Focus Timer' must have a 'Zen Mode' that hides all other UI elements.
Implement a 'Streak Flame' icon that changes color based on streak length (Orange -> Red -> Purple).
Use the 'sonner' library for toast notifications (e.g., 'You earned 50 coins!').
Ensure the Theme Toggle is prominent in the Profile section.
For the Dashboard, use a Bento Grid layout: Large block for 'Weekly Focus', medium for 'Coins', small for 'Streak'.
Anti-Cheat: Listen for 'visibilitychange' events. If document.hidden is true, pause the timer and show a warning modal on return.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic gradients. Use noise textures or sharp borders.
Make sure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Ensure mobile responsiveness is the priority (PWA).
